title: Before the Storm
description: After escaping the dragon attack on Helgen, the player is directed to Riverwood to seek help from Alvor or Gerdur, who then asks them to inform Jarl Balgruuf in Whiterun about the dragon threat and request soldiers to protect Riverwood.

base_facts: Imperial soldier who escaped Helgen during the dragon attack.
His uncle Alvor is the blacksmith in Riverwood.

HEAD_TO_RIVERWOOD: Directed the player to seek out Alvor in Riverwood for shelter and supplies.

base_facts: Stormcloak soldier who escaped Helgen during the dragon attack.
His sister Gerdur lives in Riverwood.

HEAD_TO_RIVERWOOD: Directed the player to seek out Gerdur in Riverwood for shelter and supplies.

base_facts: Worried about the dragon threat to the defenseless village.

INFORM_JARL: Asked the player to inform Jarl Balgruuf about the dragon attack and request soldiers to protect Riverwood.

base_facts: Runs the lumber mill in Riverwood, Ralof's sister.
Worried about the dragon threat to the defenseless village.

INFORM_JARL: Asked the player to inform Jarl Balgruuf about the dragon attack and request soldiers to protect Riverwood.

base_facts: Jarl of Whiterun, rules from Dragonsreach.
Concerned about the security of his hold.

WARN_JARL: Learned of the dragon attack on Helgen from the player.
Agreed to send soldiers to protect Riverwood.
Rewarded the player with a piece of leveled armor.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Rewarded the player with a piece of leveled armor, choosing light or heavy based on their skill aptitude; grants heavy armor if both are equal.
Dispatched three Whiterun guards to Riverwood to defend the village against the dragon threat.
His disposition toward the player increased by one point.
Now seeks further help investigating the dragon threat, leading to a request involving Bleak Falls Barrow.

beats.comment: Player is directed to Riverwood after escaping Helgen. Stage 10/20.
Alvor or Gerdur tells the player to inform the Jarl about the dragon. Stage 30.
Player tells Jarl Balgruuf about the dragon attack on Helgen. Stage 110.
Quest complete. Jarl rewards player with leveled armor and sends troops to Riverwood. Stage 160.
